ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels occupying approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area, creating a high-contrast ratio between the primary pigmentation and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark field. High-intensity white pixels are distributed as discrete punctate clusters and thin linear streaks scattered across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes, with a higher concentration of white focal points on the lower half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge presents low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge presents high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jaggedness with distinct V-shaped tissue loss in the medial section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex trajectory from the central notch region extending distally to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete white circular pixel clusters are visible, notably a cluster near the right lobe's medial edge and several near the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, with several sets of parallel lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe, and widespread white linear rake marks across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, irregular protrusions (likely barnacles or callosities) at the distal tip of the left lobe.
